economics.context_preflight_note: Each recorded trim step makes apply-template and tokenize requests. Failed preflights before a completion record are not included. These CPU helper requests are not model-generation calls or additional measured model tokens.

native_runtime.note: Decode excludes the first token per request, matching native predicted_n-1 timing semantics. HTTP time is not TTFT. Energy and peak device utilization were not sampled.

reason.decision: Abort the entire three-arm attempt before hidden grading, preserve all calls and available checkpoints, verify equivalent prompt selection with a more efficient preflight, then use a fresh freeze. No correctness outcome was used to select a treatment for rerun.
reason.matched_repair: The separately scheduled matched-repair experiment may proceed with its original frozen provider; short trajectories have a separate scope.
reason.reason: Context preflight repeatedly rebuilds and tokenizes progressively shortened copies of complete retained history. Observed 288-290 removed messages implies 145-146 template/tokenizer iterations per request. This consumes the stage wall budget independently of model inference.
